results.query:
PREFIX smtg: <https://w3id.org/smtg/ontology#>

results.note: uses the layout → face-configuration mapping instead of memorising layout codes.
results.query:
PREFIX smtg: <https://w3id.org/smtg/ontology#>
PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>

PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?name ?layoutLabel (COUNT(?f) AS ?faces) WHERE {
  ?card smtg:name ?name ; smtg:hasLayout ?layout ; smtg:hasFace ?f .
  ?layout smtg:impliesFaceConfiguration <https://w3id.org/smtg/vocab/face-configuration/same-side-parts> ; skos:prefLabel ?layoutLabel .

results.title: Printings sharing an illustration

results.query:
PREFIX smtg: <https://w3id.org/smtg/ontology#>

PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX v: <https://w3id.org/smtg/vocab/>
SELECT ?illustration (COUNT(DISTINCT ?printing) AS ?printings) (SAMPLE(?name) AS ?card) WHERE {
  ?printing smtg:hasPrintedFace ?pf ; smtg:isPrintingOf/smtg:name ?name .
  ?pf smtg:showsIllustration ?illustration .
} GROUP BY ?illustration HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?printing) > 1) ORDER BY DESC(?printings)

results.query:

results.title: Claims by kind, authority and source
results.question: How many claims of each kind exist, with which epistemic status, from which source dataset?
results.note: documented combos, tag beliefs, authoritative legality reports and statistical observations stay distinguishable.
results.query:
PREFIX smtg: <https://w3id.org/smtg/ontology#>
PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX v: <https://w3id.org/smtg/vocab/>
SELECT ?claimClass ?status ?dataset (COUNT(?c) AS ?n) WHERE {
  ?c a ?cls ; smtg:hasEpistemicStatus/skos:notation ?status ; smtg:observedIn/smtg:snapshotOf/rdfs:label ?dataset .
  ?cls rdfs:subClassOf* smtg:Claim ; rdfs:label ?claimClass .
  FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?c a ?sub . ?sub rdfs:subClassOf ?cls . FILTER(?sub != ?cls) }
} GROUP BY ?claimClass ?status ?dataset ORDER BY DESC(?n)

results.title: Ambiguous subtype words
results.question: Which subtype words occur in more than one type-qualified scheme (same label, different concepts)?
results.query:
PREFIX smtg: <https://w3id.org/smtg/ontology#>
PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX v: <https://w3id.org/smtg/vocab/>
SELECT ?word (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?schemeLabel; separator=' | ') AS ?schemes) WHERE {
  ?c a/rdfs:subClassOf smtg:Subtype ; skos:notation ?word ; skos:inScheme/rdfs:label ?schemeLabel .
} GROUP BY ?word HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) > 1) ORDER BY ?word
